create_token.title: Create Token
create_token.summary: Generate a new customer token from the Token section.
steps: Open the Token section.
Select the service requested by the customer.
Enter the customer information.
Click Generate Token.
Save or print the generated token.
create_token.details: Make sure the selected branch, service, and counter availability match the customer's request before generating the token.

check_queue.title: Check Queue
check_queue.summary: Review waiting and active tokens from the queue dashboard.
steps: Open the Queue section.
Choose the branch and service filter.
Review waiting, serving, skipped, and completed tokens.
Use search if you need a specific token.
Refresh the view if live updates are paused.
check_queue.details: Queue status may differ by branch, service, and counter assignment.

cancel_token.title: Cancel Token
cancel_token.summary: Cancel a token that should no longer be served.
steps: Open the token details from the queue list.
Confirm the token number and customer information.
Click Cancel Token.
Choose a cancellation reason if required.
Confirm the cancellation.
cancel_token.details: Cancelled tokens should remain visible in history for audit and reporting.

call_next.title: Call Next Token
call_next.summary: Call the next waiting token for the assigned counter.
steps: Open the Counter dashboard.
Confirm your active branch, service, and counter.
Click Call Next.
Wait for the token to appear as serving.
Proceed with service or mark the token as skipped if the customer is absent.
call_next.details: Only counters assigned to the selected service should call tokens from that queue.

transfer_token.title: Transfer Token
transfer_token.summary: Move a token to another service or counter.
steps: Open the active token details.
Click Transfer.
Select the target service, queue, or counter.
Add a transfer note if needed.
Confirm the transfer.
transfer_token.details: Transfers are useful when a customer selected the wrong service or needs specialist handling.

queue_status.title: Queue Status
queue_status.summary: Understand queue load, waiting count, and service progress.
steps: Open the queue dashboard.
Select the branch and service.
Check waiting count and currently serving token.
Review estimated wait time if enabled.
Use analytics for historical trends.
queue_status.details: Live status can later be connected to AI Queue APIs.

tv_display.title: TV Display Setup
steps: Open TV Display settings.
Select the branch and display layout.
Choose the services or counters to show.
Copy or open the display URL on the TV browser.
Test token announcements and audio volume.
tv_display.details: Use a dedicated browser profile or kiosk mode for reliable display playback.

analytics_help.title: Analytics Help
analytics_help.summary: Use analytics to understand service performance.
steps: Open Analytics.
Select the date range.
Filter by branch, service, or counter.
Review wait time, service time, skipped tokens, and throughput.
Export reports if needed.
analytics_help.details: Analytics can reveal peak hours, staff utilization, and service bottlenecks.

login_help.title: Login Help
login_help.summary: Resolve common sign-in and access issues.
steps: Confirm the email or username is correct.
Check that the user belongs to the correct branch or role.
Use Forgot Password if credentials are invalid.
Clear browser cache if the page loops.
Contact an administrator if the account is disabled.
login_help.details: For production, login help should connect to AI Queue authentication and role management rules.

branch_management.title: Branch Management
steps: Open Branch Management.
Click Add Branch or select an existing branch.
Enter branch name, code, location, and contact details.
Assign services and operating hours.
Save and verify the branch appears in filters.
branch_management.details: Branch configuration affects queue routing, counters, users, and reports.

counter_management.title: Counter Management
steps: Open Counter Management.
Choose the branch.
Click Add Counter or edit an existing counter.
Assign supported services and counter users.
Save and test by calling a token.
counter_management.details: Counters should be named clearly so staff and display screens show consistent information.

feedback.title: Feedback
steps: Open Feedback or Customer Satisfaction.
Select the branch and date range.
Review ratings, comments, and complaint categories.
Follow up on low ratings.
Use reports to identify recurring issues.
feedback.details: Feedback data can later be connected to customer records and service history.

support.title: Contact Support
support.summary: Escalate an issue to the support team.
steps: Collect the issue description.
Note the branch, user, token number, and time of issue.
Capture a screenshot if possible.
Send the details to AI Queue support.
Track the support response.
support.details: For urgent production issues, include logs and exact reproduction steps.
